```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(randomForest)
library(pROC)

#-------------------------------------------
# Function: Train Random Forest cumulatively
#-------------------------------------------
train_rf_cumulative <- function(train_file, test_file, lags_to_include, seed=123) {
  
  # Load data
  train_data <- read.csv(train_file)
  test_data <- read.csv(test_file)
  
  # Target variable
  target_col <- "status_label_3yr"
  
  # Identify base and lag variables
  all_features <- names(train_data)
  
  # Base year: variables like X1, X2, X3, ...
  base_vars <- all_features[str_detect(all_features, "^X[0-9]+$")]
  
  # Start with base
  predictor_cols <- base_vars
  
  # Add lag year variables progressively
  if (length(lags_to_include) > 0) {
    for (lag in lags_to_include) {
      lag_pattern <- paste0("_", lag, "yr$")
      lag_vars <- all_features[str_detect(all_features, lag_pattern)]
      predictor_cols <- c(predictor_cols, lag_vars)
    }
  }
  
  # Diagnostic message
  message("Model using ", length(predictor_cols), " predictors, including lags: ", paste(lags_to_include, collapse = ", "))
  
  # Select columns
  selected_cols <- c(target_col, predictor_cols)
  train_data <- train_data %>% select(any_of(selected_cols))
  test_data <- test_data %>% select(any_of(selected_cols))
  
  # Convert target to factor
  train_data[[target_col]] <- as.factor(train_data[[target_col]])
  test_data[[target_col]] <- as.factor(test_data[[target_col]])
  
  # Drop unused factor levels
  train_data[[target_col]] <- droplevels(train_data[[target_col]])
  test_data[[target_col]] <- droplevels(test_data[[target_col]])
  
  # Train Random Forest
  set.seed(seed)
  rf_model <- randomForest(
    formula = as.formula(paste(target_col, "~ .")),
    data = train_data,
    ntree = 500,
    mtry = sqrt(ncol(train_data)-1),
    importance = TRUE,
    strata = train_data[[target_col]],
    sampsize = rep(min(table(train_data[[target_col]])), 2)
  )
  
  # Predictions and ROC
  prob_test <- predict(rf_model, test_data, type="prob")[,2]
  roc_obj <- roc(test_data[[target_col]], prob_test)
  auc_value <- auc(roc_obj)
  
  return(list(model=rf_model, roc=roc_obj, auc=auc_value))
}

#-------------------------------------------
# Train models cumulatively
#-------------------------------------------

rf_base <- train_rf_cumulative("../data/train_scaled.csv", "../data/test_scaled.csv", lags_to_include=c())

# OOB Error and Variable Importance for Base Year
cat("Base Year Random Forest OOB Error:\n")
print(rf_base$model$err.rate[nrow(rf_base$model$err.rate), "OOB"])
varImpPlot(rf_base$model, main="Variable Importance - Base Year")

rf_lag1 <- train_rf_cumulative("../data/train_scaled.csv", "../data/test_scaled.csv", lags_to_include=c(1))
rf_lag2 <- train_rf_cumulative("../data/train_scaled.csv", "../data/test_scaled.csv", lags_to_include=c(1,2))
rf_lag3 <- train_rf_cumulative("../data/train_scaled.csv", "../data/test_scaled.csv", lags_to_include=c(1,2,3))

#-------------------------------------------
# Variable Importance - Base Year
#-------------------------------------------
varImpPlot(rf_base$model, main="Variable Importance - Base Year")

#-------------------------------------------
# ROC Curves
#-------------------------------------------
plot(rf_base$roc, col="#1b9e77", lwd=2, main="ROC Curves - Base vs Lag Models")
lines(rf_lag1$roc, col="#d95f02", lwd=2)
lines(rf_lag2$roc, col="#7570b3", lwd=2)
lines(rf_lag3$roc, col="#e7298a", lwd=2)
abline(a=0, b=1, lty=2, col="gray")

legend("bottomright",
       legend=paste(c("Base", "Base+Lag1", "Base+Lag2", "Base+Lag3"),
                    "AUC=", round(c(rf_base$auc, rf_lag1$auc, rf_lag2$auc, rf_lag3$auc), 3)),
       col=c("#1b9e77","#d95f02","#7570b3","#e7298a"), lwd=2, bty="n")

#-------------------------------------------
# AUC Comparison Table
#-------------------------------------------
auc_df <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Base", "Base+Lag1", "Base+Lag2", "Base+Lag3"),
  AUC = c(rf_base$auc, rf_lag1$auc, rf_lag2$auc, rf_lag3$auc)
)
print(auc_df)


```
